verses.text: kaana yahiinuhur riyaah kamaa yahiinuhur rimaah
wahwa ghaniyyun han silaah birabbihil mukarrimi
yaa rabbi salli sarmadaa halan nabiyyi ahmadaa
wa aalihi zawil hudaa wa sahbihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbi salli abadaa halaa nabiyyin habadaa
wa aalihi zawin nadaa wa sahbihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbi salli kulla hiin halaa rasuulikal amiin
wa aalihi zawil yaqiin wa sahbihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbi salli fid duhuur halal lazii mahas subuur
wa aalihi zawil hubuur wa sahbihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbi salli kulla haam halan nabii khayril anaam
wa aalihi halaa dawaam wa sahbihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbi salli fil wuquut halal fasiihi zis sukuut
wa aalihi zawil qunuut wa sahbihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbi salli fin nahaar halan nabii fakhri nizaar
wa aalihi zawil fakhaar wa sahbihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbi fis sabaah halan nabiyyi zis salaah
wa aalihi zawil falaah wa sahbihi wa sallimi
salli wa sallim fil masaa wal layli yaa man qadusaa
halaa ra-iisir ru-asaa khayril baraayaa sullami
yaa rabbi salli bisalaam halan nabiyyi fii dawaam
wal aali was sahbil kiraam waqbal bihi muntazami
salli halaa laysin shafaa biyawmi badrin iz wafaa
mahas sihaabi hunafaa bahahdihil muhazzami
sallim halaa badrin jalaa dujal quluubi wa halaa
zawil maqaamaatil hulaa wa hizbihi wa hazzimi
qad qaama khayrul bashari wasta khiyaariz zumari
ilaa zawit takabburi kal badri wasta anjumi
yawman bihish taddan nidaal yawman bihish taddal qitaal
yawma tahaarufir rijaal yawmar ridaa wal wajami
wa zaalikal yawmu falaah lizih tidaa-in wa rabaah
lizir tiqaa-in wa salaah likulli shakhsin muslimi
yawmun bihi qad ghafaraa zanuuba man qad hadaraa
qitaa lahu rabbal waraa kabiiratan kalamami
laaqaa zawul khayris sihaab fiihi zawid dayris sihaab
wa hum mahan usdun ghidaab zawur tifaahi himami
tanaa zuhul mawta mahaa wal kullu minhum shajuhaa
yabghil liqaa aw yusrahaa lihubbi maahil ghumami
wa qaataluu man qad nahaa humu shafiihush shufahaa
hattal ghubaaru satahaa bayna jabaanin wa kami
summa nahaa minas samaa khaylun wa jundun hazumaa
ilaa ra-iisil kuramaa bishran bighayri wa kami
amaddahu rabbul anaam bijundi amlaakin hizaam
lihadadin laa lilihaam ardaw zawit tahazzumi
wa fiihimu iz waraduu khaliilihul mumajjadu
jibriilu nihamas sanadu fawqa jawaadin shayzami
wa saarahuu ilal kifaah mahas suyuufi war rimaah
hubba salaahin wa falaah khalfal imaamil ahzami
wa fiihimul muhaqqiqu sayyidunal muwaffaqu
asdaqu man qad saddaquu bil hashimiyyil halami
sidiiquhul mukabbaru zul haybatil muwaqqaru
aniisuhul musabbaru fil ghaari bahdal ahlami
wa fiihimul mubash-sharu bikulli khayrin humaru
sayyidunal mu-tamiru hizatu kulli muslimi
wa fiihimu man nakahaa bintii ra-isis sulahaa
nuurayni hiina aflahaa bihatii kulli ma-sami
sayyidunal mujammalu husmaanu man qad qataluu
wahwa izan yurattilu kitaaba muhtil aksami
wa fiihimul jaalil wasan abul husayni wal hasan
baabul huluumi wal khatan abush shiraafil anjumi
sayyidunal mukarramu haliyyuhul muhazzamu
murdil hidal hasamsamu maahil azaa wa wajami
bizaalikal yawmi hasal lanaa amaanun min wajal
wa min hanaa-in wa khajal wa min jawan wa nadami
bihi ghaniinaa lil jinaan han ghazwatin wa han hawaan
bihi lanaa taabaz zamaan maha qabuulil khidami
falnahmadil laaha halaa najaatinaa mimman qalaa
wa kulli sharrin musjalaa bil mustafal muqaddami
innii ukhaatibul jamiil fiihi wa fil aalil huduul
wa sahbihi bilaa khumuul bisalliyan wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa yaa khillanaa yaa hibbanaa
salli halaa sayyidinaa muhammadin wa sallimi
wa aalihi wa sahbihi wa zii tahalluqin bihi
min awliyaa-i hizbihi wal tataqabbal qalami
warda hanis sahbil kiraam ridan yaquudu lil maraam
wa liya kun yaa zal anaam bila hidan aw walami
washkur salaatiya halaa sayyidinaa baabil hulaa
watil qasiidataq balaa liwajhikal mukarrami
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa khayri nabiyyin ursilaa
muhammadin wa zid hulaa ummatihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa khayri rasuulin fuddilaa
muhammadin wa hassilaa kitaabatii wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa khayri nabiyyin qad halaa
muhammadin wal taqbalaa khattii bihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa khayri rasuulin bujjilaa
muhammadin wa jammilaa haalii bihi wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa khayri shafiihin qubilaa
muhammadin wa kammilaa qasdii bihi wa sallimi
